ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels localized in central lobe regions and 55% low-intensity black pixels localized at margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central regions of both lobes contain large contiguous white geometric blobs. Extensive black mottling and pixel-level speckling are concentrated along the inner margins near the notch and the entire trailing edge boundary. The right lobe (viewer perspective) shows a higher density of fine-grained black pixel clusters within the white region compared to the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 110-120 degrees; bounding box depth is high relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire visible span. Notable macro-level indentation (notch) located on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 40% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute tips that show slight downward curvature (pointing toward the water surface).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, deep irregular notch or physical trauma mark is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'salt and pepper' pigmentation pattern on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, where small black pixel clusters are densely overlaid on a white background.
